title: Control of Single Flip-flops
text:
The control gates for the seven flip-flops can be determined in a similar manner. For example, Table 5-6 shows that IEN may change as a result of the two instructions ION and IOF.
pB_7: IEN \leftarrow 1
pB_6: IEN \leftarrow 0
where p = D_7 I T_3 and B_7 and B_6 are bits 7 and 6 of IR, respectively. Moreover, at the end of the interrupt cycle IEN is cleared to 0.
RT_2: IEN \leftarrow 0
If we use a JK flip-flip for IEN, the control gate logic will be as shown in Fig. 5-17.
